summary: Solid implementation with strong PowerShell conventions (CmdletBinding, parameter validation, error handling). Workflow structure is correct with job dependencies and pinned action refs. Minor issues: (1) top-level permissions apply to all jobs—unit-tests job doesn't need pull-requests:write (lines 25-30 should not override); (2) JSON config structure undocumented in workflow—users must reverse-engineer from rules.json; (3) workflow doesn't validate actionlint as required (requirement stated but not implemented in Run-ActTests.ps1); (4) PRLabelAssigner.Tests.ps1 referenced in workflow but not provided (line 24 assumes this file exists). Glob-to-regex conversion is well-implemented; output ordering (priority desc, then alpha) is deterministic. Run-ActTests.ps1 regex parsing for FINAL_LABELS could be fragile if act output format changes, though current pattern is reasonable. Overall, maintainable and testable—would ship with minor documentation and permission refinements.
